limits: A single local machine with two real loopback TCP clients and eight one-block iron structures.
A server-side velocity driver exercises native stepping and network publication; this is not keyboard skill or standing-contact validation.
87.5% is the reduction in pose message count relative to one message per entry, not an FPS, CPU, latency or byte-volume improvement.
Tick interval percentiles are observations of this fixture, not an isolated server CPU benchmark.
Collision-free deletion, viewer interest transitions and live-world disconnect cleanup are covered; WAN jitter, large modpacks and long-duration soak remain pending.

validation_reuse: Explicitly selected specialized scenes may be reused only when their relevant code/configuration is unchanged; final whole-source hashes are frozen for final full tests and builds.
limits: User confirmed same-dimension structure teleport in this batch; cross-dimension ownership migration remains future work. Host riders do not automatically accompany a structure teleport. Multi-chunk partial rigid bodies are refused by single-chunk pair swaps.

Native connectivity scans at most 4096 cells / 64 fragments; complete payload journal remains bounded to 1 MiB. Unsupported contents, open containers, loose plot entities or unprovable nozzle mappings are retained/refused rather than guessed.

Kinetic launch is 75/90 blocks per second and enhancement ends after 64 cumulative center-of-mass blocks without an explosion when no valid contact occurred. Limits: 4 records per actor, 16 active flights, 64 total records including settlement, 128 boxes, 31-block COM envelope.

Terrain penetration uses a 0.02-block weapon contact envelope and bounded shared damage permissions/budgets; it does not shrink physical collision shapes or load missing chunks. Protection/coverage/budget failure is not explosion authority.

The final hard-contact fixture uses projectileSourceChanges=2 to force real child publication; production default is 128. Actual T-shaped 8-cell break-up preserves 7 iron blocks, 1 chest, 3 diamonds and produces 2 verified children with no orphan content.

Synchronous relocation was tested within an immediate pre-clear path, including BreakBlockEvent. Already accepted multi-slice explosion mutations are not given an atomic rollback or a new global reentrant-cancel contract.

Fracture faults cover same-process exceptions before/after ownership commit. Hard termination/power-loss, every I/O failure combination and high-density long-duration stress are not certified by these scenes.

TCP multiplayer evidence is two real clients / eight dynamic bodies and lifecycle transitions. 87.5 percent is the pose-message count reduction in sampled frames, not whole-network byte savings or an FPS benchmark.

Graph scenes run the real VM/server skill paths but do not send graph-save/execute packets or use human keyboard actions. Legacy advanced editor long-display omission remains unresolved; the new basic two-node views were visually reviewed.

General S4 impulse fracture planning API, cross-dimension transfer, long-term ledger GC, full native contact stress and arbitrary third-party block compatibility remain outside this completed same-dimension feature batch.
prior_attempts: Initial compilation failures while parallel subtasks were being authored (missing vector imports/type inference, EntityType.COW mapping, final healthy field) were corrected before final tests.
Older unit expectations for teleport target options and kinetic speed were updated without weakening observed behavior assertions.

Unpaletted 4096-cell fracture images exceeded the existing NBT accounting limit; a full-payload palette plus coordinate/index arrays now passes low-diversity 4096-cell persistence and explicit over-budget rejection tests.
Native launch registration originally skipped its first Pre prediction due to Post/Pre sharing level gameTime. Corrected initial prediction phase and kept per-tick deduplication.
Native CCD rims blocked a nominal one-cell opening; weapon contact clearance is now 0.02 without changing physics/body shapes or bypassing permission checks.
Sable COM re-anchoring invalidated never-admitted cells in one slice; only unchanged complete payloads that never entered admission/loot are freshly observed under current permissions.

Native-r5 chest count failure was a measurement-window error. Read-only saved host MCA proves chest1/diamonds3/iron7; fixture window and baseline difference were corrected, with production loot unchanged.
Native-r6 missed a real post-step bouncing hard contact. Observed sweep and conservative post-step collision evidence fixed it; final r8 passes strictly.
Sable chunk exchange preserves only matching original carried contact under identical terrain translation; new walls, deeper overlap, rotation and stale source observations remain rejected.

Multiplayer r1 screenshot obstruction, r2 first-Post disconnect timing and r3 shared ImGui temporary DLL contention were retained as prior evidence; final r4 uses separate role temp directories and verifies eight live projections are cleared after actual disconnection.

Immediate paths gained an optional lightweight SourceWitness and a real callback relocation regression so cancellation cannot continue clearing the previous trajectory or zero the post-teleport velocity.
